records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the three months ended March 31, 2023, revenue increased $111 million or 23.5% and net income increased $1 million when compared to the corresponding period of 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We offer higher value solutions in key product lines in the U.S. which broaden and deepen our customer relationships and related product line value.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The average price per short ton of Hot-Rolled Coil increased 15.4% (from $717.70 per short ton to $828.17 per short ton) in the first quarter of 2023 compared to the fourth quarter of 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The average price per barrel of West Texas Intermediate Crude declined 8.1% (from $82.79 per barrel to $76.08 per barrel), and natural gas prices declined 52.3% (from $5.55 per MMBtu to $2.65 per MMBtu) in the first quarter of 2023 compared to the fourth quarter of 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the three months ended March 31, 2023, the Company generated an operating profit of $35 million compared to an operating profit of $23 million for the corresponding period of 2022.
